info.background_text:
A spring-lit girl with a bright smile.
A discipline committee member attending the academy. She’s well regarded for her soft-spoken and gentle nature. Contrary to her appearance, she is a huge eater and especially fond of sweets. She may deny any teasing all she wants, but she can’t hide the look of pure joy on her face whenever she’s tasting food.
